tldr: Mars through the 5th house brings focus to creativity, pleasure, romance, children, and joy.
body: Mars transiting the 5th house energizes creativity, pleasure, romance, children, and joy. For about six weeks, drive, heat, conflict, desire, and action move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is an activation transit: it brings momentum and courage, but also heat that needs a clear outlet.
business: Mars supports creative output and playful risk: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Impulsiveness, conflict, burnout, or performing for validation.
advice: Aim the fire in the 5th house deliberately. Work with creativity, pleasure, romance, children, and joy without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from approved project house-transit material.
